benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: SBI Card ELITE is an all-rounder card offering benefits across multiple categories including movies, dining, rewards and more. Cardholders can earn decent rewards on their everyday spends along with substantial milestone benefits, making it a good choice for high-spenders. The card also offers movie tickets worth Rs. 6,000 in a year along with travel benefits like complimentary domestic and international lounge access and low foreign exchange mark-up fee.

faqs.q: How to redeem SBI Elite Credit Card reward points?
faqs.a: The reward points accumulated on SBI credit cards can be redeemed online by logging into SBI Card’s official website. They can also be redeemed by visiting the partner merchant store. Alternatively, you can also call on SBI Card helpline 39020202 (prefix local STD code) to redeem your reward points. Points can be redeemed in the multiples of 2000 points unless otherwise stated.

faqs.q: Is SBI Card Elite credit card internationally acceptable?
faqs.a: Yes. SBI ELITE credit card is accepted at over 24 million Visa outlets worldwide, including 3,25,000 outlets in India.

faqs.q: Does the card offer fuel surcharge waiver & if yes, where can I avail it?
faqs.a: Yes, SBI Elite Credit Card offers fuel surcharge waiver. It can be availed at any petrol pump in India.

faqs.q: Can I transfer my outstanding balance on any other bank’s credit card?
faqs.a: Yes, SBI Card Elite credit card provides the facility of ‘Balance Transfer’ through which you can transfer balances from other bank’s credit cards to SBI Card Elite.

faqs.q: Does the card provide Fraud liability cover?
faqs.a: Yes, you get a cover of Rs. 1 Lakh against fraudulent transactions.

faqs.q: What should I do if I lose my credit card in a foreign country?
faqs.a: In case you lose your SBI Elite Credit Card when travelling to a foreign country, you can call on a 24×7 Visa helpline number to get it replaced.

faqs.q: How to get free movie tickets on SBI Elite card?
faqs.a: When booking tickets on the BookMyShow App or website, you have to apply the SBI Signature/ELITE Credit Card offer under the ‘Unlock Offer/Apply Promocode’ section. You have to book minimum two tickets to avail the offer and a maximum discount of Rs. 500 can be availed.

faqs.q: Is SBI Elite a good card?
faqs.a: SBI Elite is a decent all-rounder credit card as it caters to some everyday spends like grocery, departmental stores and dining. The card also charges a low forex mark-up fee and provides complimentary Priority Pass membership, along with free domestic and international lounge visits. However, the reward rate on the card is too low for the annual fee charged. If you are looking for all-round benefits, getting a premium credit card like HDFC Diners Club Black or ICICI Emeralde Private would be better.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SBI Prime and Elite card?
faqs.a: SBI Prime and SBI Elite both offer similar benefits around rewards, lounge access, etc. along with network-based benefits. SBI PRIME is available at an annual fee of Rs. 2,999 whereas SBI ELITE charges Rs. 4,999. ELITE provides a higher number of free lounge visits, low forex mark-up fee benefit and golf benefits, which are not available on the PRIME Card.

faqs.q: How to get a SBI Elite credit card welcome gift voucher?
faqs.a: You will receive an SMS on your registered mobile number within 15 days of joining fee deduction from your card amount. The SMS will include the e-voucher options. You can respond with the given code and the e voucher will be sent to your mobile number within 30 days.
